newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish rate to end 1997 at 4.5 percent - bank.
newsitem.headline: Spanish rate to end 1997 at 4.5 percent - bank.

text.p: Spanish key money market rates should end 1997 at around 4.5 percent, to reach four percent in 1998, a study by Banco Central Hispano (BCH) said on Thursday.

The likely fall from the current 5.25 percent level would be the outcome of two conflicting forces -- European convergence pushing rates down and a recovering economy requiring cautious monetary policies.
